pr_title: Add support for importing files on Android
pr_body:
Supersedes #5265
Closes #6525

- [x] Depends on #11115

# Summary

This adds the ability to import files on Android, by adding a way to import files from a Stream and a filename in ArchiveModelManager as starting from 7.0, apps don't expose anymore paths to files but content URIs, which can at best be used to get a stream to the file and the filename. 

Turns out passing the filename around is required because some model managers (namely SkinManager) are using the archive reader name to populate the skin info. 

This adds ability to import beatmap / skins by clicking them in downloads (ie: in a web brower) or by sharing the file to osu! through the share button in a file explorer.

## Testing

I haven't added any automated tests for importing but guess I could add one if prompted to and if it's deemed necessary.
Tested this on three of my android devices which are unfortunately all above > 9.0 so, if anyone owns an actual device running under < 7.0, testing this works would be appreciated.
pr_comments: Actually this isn't ready yet for review and is missing robustness in retrieving filenames correctly so I'll close this and reopen when deemed ready.
I guess this is ready for review. `osu://` URL handling will come in a separate PR.
I guess I'll mark this as dependent on #11115 until that's merged.
Test failure is unrelated an seems to stem from this place : https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/6da854e37c3eb3b8f426904895f6ece374bea498/osu.Game.Tests/Visual/Gameplay/TestSceneFailJudgement.cs#L26-L33
It's a known (albeit rare and not completely explained) failure.

I've tidied this up, but haven't tested on device. @bdach are you able to give it a quick run and maybe touch on my remaining review point?

I think it looks okay for a code perspective otherwise, so feel free to comment/merge as required.
Yep, I'll fire up windows today and give this a spin. Was on my tentative to-do list anyway.

On testing this, I'm getting the following:

```
2020-12-14 19:52:35.601 15937-15937/sh.ppy.osulazer E/AndroidRuntime: FATAL EXCEPTION: main
    Process: sh.ppy.osulazer, PID: 15937
    java.lang.NoSuchMethodError: no non-static method "Landroid/content/ContentResolver;.query(Landroid/net/Uri;[Ljava/lang/String;Landroid/os/Bundle;Landroid/os/CancellationSignal;)Landroid/database/Cursor;"
        at crc64f3e94a995e5d9e96.OsuGameActivity.n_onCreate(Native Method)
        at crc64f3e94a995e5d9e96.OsuGameActivity.onCreate(OsuGameActivity.java:30)
        at android.app.Activity.performCreate(Activity.java:6956)
```

Indeed this overload has only been added in [API level 26.](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/content/ContentResolver#query(android.net.Uri,%20java.lang.String[],%20android.os.Bundle,%20android.os.CancellationSignal)) Guess I'll revert to the old version that's from API 1...

Even after that, map imports are still failing here...

```
2020-12-14 19:02:38 [error]: Could not import (1130730 Au5 feat. Trove - The Journey)
2020-12-14 19:02:38 [error]: System.ArgumentException: Archive streams must be Readable and Seekable
2020-12-14 19:02:38 [error]: at SharpCompress.Archives.AbstractArchive`2[TEntry,TVolume].CheckStreams (System.IO.Stream stream) [0x00010] in <84e094a6785f4014b2dc1f205d7b9fa9>:0
2020-12-14 19:02:38 [error]: at System.Linq.
```

@Game4all have you ever seen any of these?

I've pushed changes that make this functional to me. They resolve the issues I pointed out above. I additionally reverted import of `.osr` files, as upon trying to import one, it didn't work, as `.osr`s aren't archives. Adding support for that extension is a bit more involved (need a `ZipUtils.IsZipArchive` analogue for streams, or to restructure the file type handling somewhat), so that can come in a separate pull.

I've got to say it's pretty shocking how many issues this had for me, though. Not sure how well tested this was (or if at all).

Seing that you ran into some pretty interesting issues while testing this, could you please specify on what hardware did you test this on ? ( OS version + the app used to trigger the import intent).

During the testing I have done on 3 real devices all running Android > 9.0, I never ran into any of the issues aforementioned even though I tested this works correctly with a few file explorers / firefox / chrome / downloads.

The only thing I haven't tested is replay files import (that one is actually entirely my fault, never bothered to check that replay importing was working, else would've noticed it wasn't functional)

Tested on Samsung Galaxy J7 (2016), Android version 7.0. Explains the issue with `ContentResolver` (that one's partially on me too as I suggested it off API docs not having looked at API versions properly), but the stream seekability, not so much.

From what I can see the `InputStream` returned by the content resolver [has no members for seeking](https://developer.android.com/reference/java/io/InputStream), so this likely was depending on underlying implementation details on higher API versions.

The possibility to import maps and skins by openning respective files in the app (Click-to-import)

Method: going to file manager, clicking the file, selecting it to open with osu! and import the skin/beatmap
comments:

#5761 is related but this issue seems to be more of "open with" functionality instead of "choose a file to import" in-game (specifically, the related issue is asking for a button to automatically search for importable files and import them - opsu! has a similar feature to that). I don't think either should be closed as of yet.
